_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit. config.json is ignored by git.
_host: 127.0.0.1 (default) = this PC only. Use 0.0.0.0 to reach it from your phone or another device. The app has NO password, so only do that on a private network such as Tailscale, or behind a VPN.
_cleanup_hours: Results in output/ older than this are deleted automatically (on startup and hourly). Download what you want to keep. 0 turns it off.
_library_roots: Extra folders the 'Choose from this PC' picker may read, as id: [label, path]. Downloads/Videos/Pictures/Desktop are included automatically. Nothing outside these folders is reachable.
